query:
SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables 
WHERE table_schema = DATABASE() 
AND table_name IN (
  'content', 'contentRevisions', 'contentAnalytics', 'contentRepurposed', 'contentComments',
  'gbpConnections', 'gbpLocations', 'gbpPosts', 'brandVoiceHistory', 'ads',
  'competitorKeywords', 'gapAnalysisRuns', 'savedKeywords', 'seoAuditHistory',
  'keywordRankings', 'keywordRankAlerts', 'gapKeywordBriefs', 'contentPackages',
  'notification_logs', 'email_templates', 'inbound_emails',
  'viral_topics', 'social_posts', 'content_calendar', 'heygen_sessions'
)
ORDER BY table_name;
